cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Finance Administrative Specialist to join our Finance Commercial Execution Team.
This position operates under the direct supervision of the Finance Administrator Supervisor. If you are a strong self-starter who can effectively prioritize, organize and multi-task, we invite you to apply.
The Finance Administrative Specialist will be primarily responsible for providing exceptional administrative & financial support for our sales field, while collaborating with our internal departments. This position is a complex task-based job, requiring problem solving, multi-tasking, and strong organizational skills. The role will also require you to exercise judgment by making key decisions using resources available.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Set up Billing Arrangements and Special Pricing following specific guidelines set forth by the business. Maintain a workload for specific accounts designated by strategic business unit. Drive the invoicing process by communicating with all parties when information is needed (i.e. Billing Arrangement numbers, start & end dates, invoice and billing adjustment request information, and reference numbers). Maintain a team focused environment with a high level of engagement with all members of the Commercial Execution Team. Engage in problem solving by reading and processing requests and interpreting the data to provide appropriate recommendations. Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders within Sales, Finance, and other internal departments to successfully maintain consistent billings. Assist & educate sales reps to stay compliant with corporate policies and procedures.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma/GED
2 Years of successful administrative support or technical sales support experience
Experience meeting strict deadlines
Skilled in providing excellent customer service to internal and external customers
High computer application literacy (including Microsoft Office Suite and ability to learn internal business systems)
Strong ability to multi-task and prioritize work
Excellent written and oral communication skills
Excellent organizational skills
Strong work ethic and customer service skills
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity and/or experience with SAP and CRM systems
Bachelor's or Associates degree
4 Years of successful administrative support or technical sales support experience
History of working in a field that required autonomy and self-motivation
